page.overview:
Who is The Vileness?

The Vileness is a term quietly used by some Aes Sedai to refer to a period of treachery and murder that occurred between the years and ., Vileness, the|Vileness}} It began with the discovery by the Black Ajah that the Dragon had been reborn. This was followed by a pogrom aimed at gentling or killing as many potential candidates as possible.

During the six-year period over ten-thousand men and boys would lose their lives, along with thirty to fifty Aes Sedai sisters and two Amyrlins. Only fifteen to twenty-five were men who could channel, the official number being only seven. Two-thousand of the male deaths are recorded in the secret histories of the Tower. The Vileness would also deepen already existing animosities between factions within the White Tower; most notably between the Red and Blue Ajahs.

For centuries, a secret cabal of Darkfriend Aes Sedai, the Black Ajah, existed within the White Tower. The Black Ajah recruited sisters from among all the legitimate Ajahs to serve them, and they worked in great secrecy. One of the reasons for the Black Ajah's existence was to provide the Shadow with access to the Dragon Reborn, since it was assumed that the Aes Sedai would locate and either take control of or ally with the true Dragon Reborn when he emerged. The Black Ajah was led by a Supreme Council, with one woman as Head of the Council, and reported to the Forsaken Ishamael during the rare periods when he was at liberty from Shayol Ghul.

After Gitara Moroso died the Black Ajah heard rumours connecting her death with a Foretelling, one which had the Amyrlin Seat, Tamra Ospenya, making secret and hasty plans with influential senior sisters.
